message.content:
AIVA & Grace: how the chat works today

A friendly walk-through of the real pipeline — Console → rosbridge/ROS 2 → telepathy receptor → Interactive → llama.cpp → back to the browser.

SIMULATION — not live telemetry
Current step Step 0 of 6 — User composes the sample message
STEP 0

User at Console

Composes the sample message in the browser UI.

STEP 1

Encode & publish

Cypher (reversible) → rosbridge / ROS 2 /telepathic/stimulus.

STEP 2

Telepathy receptor

ROS node decodes and calls Interactive.

STEP 3

Interactive

Assembles persona, time, profile + SQLite history.

STEP 4

llama.cpp router

Nymphaea RP streams text deltas.

STEP 5

Response returns

/telepathic/response → Console decodes & streams.

STEP 6

Memory saves

Completed exchange persisted to SQLite.

Console (simulated) — POST /api/telepathic/send

Optional capabilities — outside the text-chat path

These are supported libraries, but they are not part of the conversational flow shown above.

Canvasdrawing library
Imagingdrawing library
